title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Becomes Second-Largest in History
subtitle: The current epidemic is spreading faster than any previous version of the virus, challenging health officials in conflict-affected areas.

summary.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing its fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded. With over 3,500 confirmed cases, it has now become the second-largest outbreak in history. Health experts are struggling to contain the virus due to ongoing regional conflict and high population density. New experimental vaccines are currently being tested to fight the Bundibugyo strain. Officials warn that the situation remains critical as they work to stop the spread.
summary.zh: 剛果民主共和國正面臨史上擴散速度最快的伊波拉疫情。確診病例已超過三千五百例，成為歷史上第二大規模的疫情爆發。由於持續的區域衝突與高人口密度，衛生專家在控制病毒方面面臨嚴峻挑戰。目前正針對邦迪布焦病毒株進行新的實驗性疫苗測試。官員警告，隨著他們努力遏止疫情擴散，情況依然處於危急狀態。

paragraphs.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is currently facing a major health crisis as its latest Ebola outbreak has become the second-largest ever recorded. According to Deutsche Welle (DW) Top, the number of confirmed cases has now surpassed the total seen during the country’s previous deadliest epidemic, which occurred between 2018 and 2020. Officials reported that there are now 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five different provinces.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國（Democratic Republic of the Congo，簡稱剛果民主共和國）目前正面臨嚴重的健康危機，其最新的伊波拉病毒疫情已成為史上第二大規模的爆發。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle，簡稱德國之聲）報導，確診病例數現已超過該國二零一八年至二零二零年間最致命的那次疫情總數。官員指出，目前在五個不同的省份中，已有三千五百三十二例確診，並造成一千五百五十六人死亡。

paragraphs.en: This outbreak is moving at an alarming speed. The Guardian World reports that it is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in the history of the virus. Experts from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention noted that the virus has been unusually deadly, killing five times more people in its first three months than previous outbreaks did during the same period. The disease is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a specific type of the virus for which there is currently no standard treatment or approved vaccine.
paragraphs.zh: 這波疫情正以驚人的速度蔓延。衛報（The Guardian）報導稱，這是該病毒歷史上擴散速度最快的伊波拉疫情。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention）的專家指出，該病毒異常致命，在爆發的前三個月內，死亡人數是過去同類疫情同期的五倍。此疾病是由邦迪布焦（Bundibugyo）病毒株所引起，目前針對此特定病毒株尚無標準治療方法或核准的疫苗。

paragraphs.en: Health officials are finding it very difficult to control the spread of the disease. Prof Pierre Akilimali, who leads the Ebola response for the country’s public health institute, explained that the situation is complicated by local insecurity, mining activities, and high population density. In many areas, conflict makes it hard for medical teams to reach those who are sick. Residents in affected regions, such as Ituri, have expressed deep fear, noting that their daily lives and local development projects have come to a standstill because of the constant threat of infection.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生官員發現要控制疾病擴散極為困難。負責該國公共衛生研究所伊波拉應對工作的皮耶爾·阿基利馬利（Pierre Akilimali）教授解釋說，當地的治安不穩、採礦活動以及高人口密度使情況變得更加複雜。在許多地區，衝突導致醫療團隊難以接觸到病患。伊圖里（Ituri）等受影響地區的居民表達了深切的恐懼，並指出由於持續的感染威脅，他們的日常生活與地方發展計畫皆已陷入停滯。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian World, the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. Since then, cases have risen rapidly, with between 100 and 150 new infections confirmed each week in the Bunia and Rwampara health zones. Dr. Justus Nsio, a field manager for the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, stated that the virus was detected too late. He emphasized that health teams are now in a difficult race against time to catch up and contain the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 根據衛報報導，疫情於五月十五日正式宣布。自那時起，病例數迅速攀升，布尼亞（Bunia）與瓦姆帕拉（Rwampara）衛生區每週新增確診病例約在一百至一百五十例之間。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心的現場經理賈斯圖斯·恩西奧（Justus Nsio）博士表示，病毒發現得太晚。他強調，醫療團隊目前正處於一場艱難的與時間賽跑，試圖追趕並控制疫情。

paragraphs.en: To fight the virus, authorities have built more than 20 treatment centers and set up local laboratories for testing. They are also using community workers to help track the spread of the virus. Despite these efforts, the situation remains unstable. Deutsche Welle (DW) Top reports that the virus has spread into regions like North Kivu and South Kivu, where large areas are controlled by the M23 rebel group. This ongoing conflict makes it even harder for health workers to move safely and provide care.
paragraphs.zh: 為了對抗病毒，當局已建立了超過二十個治療中心，並設立了地方實驗室進行檢測。他們也利用社區工作人員協助追蹤病毒的擴散。儘管付出了這些努力，情況依然不穩定。德國之聲報導稱，病毒已擴散至北基伍（North Kivu）與南基伍（South Kivu）等地區，這些地方有大片區域由「三月二十三日運動」（M23）叛軍組織所控制。持續的衝突使得醫護人員更難以安全移動並提供照護。

paragraphs.en: There is, however, some hope regarding new medical research. Because there is no existing treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, scientists are working on experimental vaccines. The Guardian World reports that clinical trials for one vaccine began in early July, with about 20 people enrolled as of mid-July. Deutsche Welle (DW) Top added that another vaccine candidate is being developed by the University of Oxford, and the first volunteer recently received a dose as part of a new trial. While these developments are promising, experts caution that the research process could take several months.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在新的醫學研究方面出現了一些希望。由於目前沒有針對邦迪布焦病毒株的現成療法，科學家們正致力於研發實驗性疫苗。衛報報導稱，其中一種疫苗的臨床試驗已於七月初展開，截至七月中旬已有約二十人參與。德國之聲補充說，牛津大學（University of Oxford）正在開發另一種候選疫苗，首位志願者最近已作為新試驗的一部分接種了劑量。雖然這些進展令人期待，但專家提醒，研究過程可能還需要數個月的時間。

paragraphs.en: As the crisis continues, international cooperation is playing a role in the response. Uganda, which recently declared its own Ebola outbreak over, has sent experts to the DRC to assist in border regions like Tchomia and Kasenyi. Meanwhile, officials continue to urge the public to seek medical advice at the first sign of symptoms. As Prof Akilimali noted, the road to bringing the outbreak under control is a long one, and the success of these efforts depends on the commitment of both local authorities and international partners.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著危機持續，國際合作在應對行動中發揮了作用。剛果民主共和國的鄰國烏干達（Uganda）近期宣布其境內的伊波拉疫情已結束，並已派遣專家前往剛果民主共和國，協助喬米亞（Tchomia）與卡森伊（Kasenyi）等邊境地區。與此同時，官員持續呼籲民眾在出現症狀的第一時間尋求醫療建議。正如阿基利馬利教授所言，控制疫情的道路漫長，而這些努力的成功與否，取決於地方當局與國際夥伴的承諾。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation in which all activity has stopped.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞常與動詞 come 連用，形容活動完全停止。文中：Residents in affected regions, such as Ituri, have expressed deep fear, noting that their daily lives and local development projects have come to a standstill because of the constant threat of infection.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation where something must be done very quickly before a deadline or before it is too late.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 與時間賽跑（形容必須在極短時間內完成某事）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的慣用語，用來強調緊急性。文中：He emphasized that health teams are now in a difficult race against time to catch up and contain the disease.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Officially registered as a member or participant in a course or study.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 註冊、登記參加（通常指研究或課程）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於學校註冊，在此指參與臨床實驗的受試者。文中：The Guardian World reports that clinical trials for one vaccine began in early July, with about 20 people enrolled as of mid-July.

previousArticles.summaryEn: A major Ebola outbreak is approaching a significant and concerning milestone. Health experts are working hard to manage the spread of the virus. A new vaccine is currently in development but remains several months away from being ready. Officials are balancing the need for quick action with the requirement for careful testing. The global health community continues to watch the situation as it develops.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason why the current Ebola outbreak is considered particularly dangerous compared to previous ones?

options.A: It has already spread to more than ten provinces across the country.
options.B: It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which lacks an approved vaccine or standard treatment.
options.C: It has resulted in more total deaths than any other epidemic in history.
options.D: It started in major cities like Bunia and Rwampara simultaneously.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，該病毒屬於 Bundibugyo 變種，且目前沒有標準治療方法或核准的疫苗。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到受影響的是五個省份而非十個。選項 C 錯誤，文中指出這是「第二大」疫情，而非史上死亡人數最多。選項 D 雖然提到這些地點，但並未說明這是疫情危險的主因。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the M23 rebel group's presence in North and South Kivu hinder the medical response?

options.A: The rebel group is actively destroying the newly built local laboratories.
options.B: The group refuses to allow international experts from Uganda to enter the country.
options.C: The ongoing conflict creates an environment where health workers cannot safely access or treat patients.
options.D: The rebels have successfully developed their own experimental vaccine that conflicts with official efforts.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段與第五段，當地衝突（包括 M23 叛軍控制區域）使得醫療團隊難以進入受影響地區提供護理。選項 A 與 D 在文中並未提及。選項 B 錯誤，因為文中提到烏干達專家是來協助邊境地區，並未提到叛軍阻止其入境，推論衝突導致的安全問題才是主要阻礙。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'a difficult race against time' imply about the health officials' situation?

options.A: They are competing in a professional sporting event to raise funds.
options.B: They must work extremely quickly to contain the virus before it spreads further.
options.C: They are waiting for a specific deadline to pass before they can start testing.
options.D: They are trying to finish their research before the rainy season begins.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「race against time」意指時間緊迫，必須爭分奪秒地採取行動以控制疫情擴散。選項 A 將其誤解為體育賽事。選項 C 與 D 的內容在文中並未出現，且與「爭取時間」的隱喻不符，這是一個關於緊急程度的慣用語。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the overall message of the article?

options.A: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is being successfully managed through international aid.
options.B: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is less harmful than previously thought by scientists.
options.C: The DRC is facing a severe, rapidly spreading Ebola crisis complicated by conflict and a lack of proven treatments.
options.D: Local residents in the DRC are refusing to participate in medical trials due to fear of the virus.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。這篇文章全面探討了疫情的嚴峻性、擴散速度、醫療資源的缺乏（無疫苗）以及當地衝突帶來的挑戰，這是文章的核心主旨。選項 A 過於樂觀，與文中提到的「情況不穩定」矛盾。選項 B 與事實不符。選項 D 雖然提到居民有恐懼感，但這只是影響因素之一，並非全文的主旨。
